# Cryptik

> Advanced onboard systems for spacecraft navigation, orbit determination, and real-time state estimation.

## About Cryptik
Cryptik develops next-generation hardware and software solutions to solve the onboard navigation problem in space. Our systems fuse optical/thermal imagery with multi-sensor telemetry to ensure continuous, high-precision guidance even during GNSS dropouts and eclipses.

## Products & Technology
- **Orbit Determination**: Real-time onboard orbital state calculation.
- **Sensor Fusion**: Fusing GNSS, inertial measurement units (IMUs), and camera inputs.
- **Eclipse Navigation**: Visible and thermal imaging fusion to hold tracking locks when visible sensors lose the sun.

## Careers & Team
We are building a world-class team of spacecraft system engineers, hardware researchers, and content creators.
- **System Engineer**: Focuses on physical satellite structures, CubeSat integration, thermal shielding, and power distribution systems (EPS).
- **Hardware Researcher**: Focuses on custom circuit design, board layout, sensor interfacing, and precision hardware integration.
- **Content Intern**: Focuses on production, editing, documentation, and capturing engineering moments.
- **Location**: Based in a sunlit villa headquarters designed for deep focus and physical testing.
